description: This file contains implementations of functions related to torch's distributed communication, including broadcasting tensors, reducing tensors (sum), scattering, and gathering across multiple GPUs or devices, primarily used for parallel processing in the PyTorch framework.

methods.name: broadcast(tensor, devices=None, *, out=None)
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor to specified GPU devices or copies into provided output tensors, for parallel data distribution.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced(tensors, devices, buffer_size=10485760)
methods.description: Broadcasts multiple tensors to specified GPUs efficiently by coalescing small tensors to reduce synchronization.

methods.name: reduce_add(inputs, destination=None)
methods.description: Sums tensors from multiple GPUs into a single tensor on a specified destination device.

methods.name: reduce_add_coalesced(inputs, destination=None, buffer_size=10485760)
methods.description: Summation of multiple tensors from different GPUs, with coalescing for efficiency.

methods.name: scatter(tensor, devices=None, chunk_sizes=None, dim=0, streams=None, *, out=None)
methods.description: Distributes (scatters) a tensor across multiple devices, optionally with specified chunk sizes.

methods.name: gather(tensors, dim=0, destination=None, *, out=None)
methods.description: Concatenates tensors from multiple devices into one tensor on a specified device.

ctags.name: scatter
ctags.pattern: /^def scatter(tensor, devices=None, chunk_sizes=None, dim=0, streams=None, *, out=None):$/
